title: Hoshino Ichika — Nervous Message Of Thanks〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Holiday
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahh♪ Another day, another good practice!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We still have some work left to do, but we've steadily been making progress...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Our goal should be to practice everything we can, so let's keep up this momentum.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, Ms. Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe.
It's really starting to feel like our show's just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! Our solo show's gonna be the most powerful ever! Humhum♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You seem pretty excited, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I am!
Practicing for our solo show's been fun, but we also get to go to the flower shop together today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's been quite a while since we last went together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you also get super pumped up the last time we went?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup♪
I'd been wanting to go ever since that time I was in the hospital.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I really wanted to see what the shop was like since the flowers I got were so cute!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Which is why I was so happy when we finally all went together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too...
All of us, together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, hello?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Oh, hello there! You're all back!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hey, Shiho, look!
These flowers are so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Which ones...?
Oh, you're right. They're adorably tiny.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Hehe. Feel free to browse all you like. Do you know which kind you're looking for today?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... We're looking for something that a friend of ours can put on display at their house. I was thinking these and these...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Ah, nice choices.
Then, I'll also throw in these ones for free. They should add a nice, colorful accent.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, for free?
Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow... They're so pretty...!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe.
I'm sure the flowers also appreciate your compliment. Anyway, I just need a second to wrap these up.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Alright, here you are.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, they're so adorable!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'm sure our friend's going to like them a lot. Right, Honami...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, they look wonderful.
And they smell so nice...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's good to hear.
By the way, what's that you're carrying...? A musical instrument?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, this? It's a guitar.
Actually, the four of us are in a band...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Wait, you are?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yes!
We've been writing our own songs and are putting on a solo show soon!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: That's incredible! Sounds like you're all really enjoying life!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you very much!
We're trying to make the most of our youth!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Most people don't usually say that out loud...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful.
Flowers are one thing, of course, but I like how music also has these healing properties.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Oh, would it be possible for me to hear some of your songs? I'd love to put them on in the shop.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
I-I-I-Ichi! This is a huge advertisement chance for us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, um... We have a channel on this video platform... We put our songs up here.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
So, I can listen to them here?
That's convenient. I should have no problem playing them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, that's—!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, you've been carrying our flyers around?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. I've been making sure to lately in the hopes that some shops will let us put them up.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Nice thinking.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Way to go, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: This is a flyer for our solo show. Could we ask you to put it up on display somewhere inside your shop?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Yes, I'd love to.
I can't guarantee how much it'll help, but I'll try finding a place where people will notice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay! Thank you very much...!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Also, how would you feel about someone my age coming to see your show?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course, we'd love to see you there!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Oh, wonderful! I'll be looking forward to it. Hehe. I'll make sure to keep this day free.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do our best♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We promise to do everything we can to give you the best performance possible...!
